title: Buying a Jacket
text:
Tom wants a new jacket. It is cold in the winter. He goes to a clothes shop in the city. The shop has many jackets.

The blue jacket is nice, but it is big. Tom asks for a smaller size. The shop assistant gives him a small jacket. Tom buys it for thirty dollars.

questions.text: Why does Tom want a new jacket?
options: He wants to be a model.

questions.text: How much does the jacket cost?
Why does Tom ask for a smaller size?
options: The blue jacket is too big for him.
He wants to give it to a friend.
The shop has no big sizes.
He does not like the color blue.

questions.text: What can we guess about the shop assistant?
options: She helps customers find the right size.
She does not work in the shop.
She wants Tom to leave the shop.
She is a friend of Tom.

vocabulary.definition: a short coat that you wear outside
a place where you buy things
having a low temperature, not warm
how big or small a piece of clothing is

paragraph_translations: Том хоче нову куртку. Взимку холодно. Він іде в магазин одягу в місті. У магазині багато курток.
Синя куртка гарна, але велика. Том просить менший розмір. Продавець дає йому меншу куртку. Том купує її за тридцять доларів.
